VI, 8ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>מן דמטון</he> (<cite ref="L00000"><he>ל</he></cite>) <he>פ׳</he> (not <cite ref="Q02191"><he>פו׳</he></cite>) when they arrived at the gates.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 1</cite> (<cite ref="T00152"><he>רבתי</he></cite>) <he>בתרע פ׳ דההיא וכ׳</he> at the gate of the entrance to that city.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 63">Gen. R. s. 63</cite> <he>פ׳ דפנייס</he> the gate of Paneas; a. fr.—
Ib., a. e. פיילי (corr. acc.).—Tanḥ., ed. Bub., Miḳḳ. 10 בפולי אחד (read: בפי׳ אחת).—Pl. ch. פִּילְוָותָא.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 20:11">Targ. Y. I Deut. XX, 11</cite> <he>פִּילְוָותָהּ</he> (Y. II <he>פִּלְוָותָא</he>, corr. acc.).—Hebr. pl. <cite ref="Q00668"><he>פִּילָאוֹת</he></cite>. Tanḥ. l. c. <he>הושיב שומרים על פתחי פ׳</he> (not <he>פתח</he>) he placed guards at all entrances.
